release_notes: **Scheduled Jobs showed live countdowns for disabled/unarmed strategies**: the Scheduled Jobs list had no idea whether a strategy was enabled or armed, so a fully-off strategy still displayed active entry/monitor jobs. Each job row now shows "disabled — will not run" or "unarmed — will run as paper, not real" based on the strategy's actual state. Manual entry/exit now warns in the response if the performance-log write fails, so a backfilled trade doesn't silently drop out of reports.
